CalendarEvent.title: CalendarEvent
CalendarEvent.description: Personal solar and lunar calendar event or smart reminder owned by a user.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated owner (must match request.auth.uid).

notes.description: Optional event notes or description (0 to 500 characters).

solarDay.description: Solar day of the month (1 to 31).

solarMonth.description: Solar month of the year (1 to 12).

lunarDay.description: Lunar day of the month (1 to 30).

lunarMonth.description: Lunar month of the year (1 to 12).

isLunarLeapMonth.description: Whether the lunar month is a leap month.

isLunarRecurring.description: Whether the event repeats annually according to the Lunar calendar (e.g., Giỗ, Tết, Rằm).

reminderMinutesBefore.description: Smart reminder offset in minutes before event (e.g., 0, 30, 60, 1440).

syncedToGoogle.description: Whether the event has been synced with Google Calendar.

UserPreference.title: UserPreference
UserPreference.description: Cloud-backed user personalization settings and smart notification preferences.

themeMode.description: Selected theme mode for battery saving and comfort.

notifyHolidays.description: Whether to notify on Vietnamese lunar and solar holidays.

notifyMung1Ram.description: Smart reminder on Lunar 1st (Mùng 1) and 15th (Rằm) each month.

defaultReminderHour.description: Preferred hour of the day for smart reminders (0 to 23).

SharedSchedule.title: SharedSchedule
SharedSchedule.description: A schedule item shared securely by an owner with a friend's email account.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who shared the schedule.

ownerName.description: Display name of the sender (1 to 100 chars).

recipientEmail.description: Target recipient's email address (3 to 150 chars).

title.description: Title of the shared event (1 to 120 chars).

solarDateIso.description: Solar date formatted YYYY-MM-DD (8 to 20 chars).

lunarDateDisplay.description: Formatted Lunar date string (1 to 60 chars).

/users/{userId}/events/{eventId}.description: User's private cloud-backed lunar and solar events.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: User's personalized UI theme and smart notification preferences.

/shared_schedules/{shareId}.description: Schedules shared between users via linked email accounts.
